about.title: About
about.description: I'm a Senior Flutter developer with a strong product focus. Building commercial apps since 2018 (desktop → mobile since 2022). I work AI-native: AI agents (Claude Code/Codex) write the code while I set the tasks, review deeply, and own the quality. I take products from zero to release: architecture (Clean Architecture), state (BLoC/Provider), realtime (WebSocket, chats, push), integrations (Firebase/IAP/Deep Links), CI/CD. Founder of Ovdix, author of Plumix.

projects.name: HR platform mobile app (iOS/Android): vacancies, CVs, applications, chats
responsibilities: Run an AI-native development process: most of the code is written by AI agents (Claude Code/Codex) — I set the tasks, review the results deeply, and own the quality
Implemented realtime chats over WebSocket (Socket.IO): message delivery and read receipts, typing indicators, state sync across screens
Built the push notification system (FCM): notification center, navigation from pushes and deep links into the right sections, notification settings screen
Delivered pixel-perfect UI from Figma: light/dark theme redesign, custom bottom sheets and draggable panels, complex animations, a design system of text styles and controls
Designed a feature-module Clean Architecture over legacy code: GetX → BLoC migration, move to auto_route, extracted a generated OpenAPI client into a separate package
Integrated payments: In-App Purchases (iOS/Android) and external payment providers
Implemented moderation flows for vacancies and CVs, reviews, and company pages
Set up GitLab CI/CD (format, analyze, tests on every MR) and releases to App Store / Google Play
Integrated AppsFlyer, Facebook SDK, and Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config — force-update mechanism)
Localized the app into 5+ languages (slang)
